quantity.name: coupled ROM
quantity.definition: coupled rotation at 7.5 Nm primary moment (mean +/- SD); text also states all other coupled rotations < 0.2-0.4 deg

source.authors: Oxland TR, Lin RM, Panjabi MM
source.journal: J Orthop Res 10(4):573-580 (DOI not printed in PDF)
source.sample: 11 fresh-frozen human T11-L1 three-vertebra specimens, all non-ligamentous soft tissue removed
source.age: mean 53 y (range illegible in scan); age/sex unknown for 3

protocol.summary: T11 and L1 potted; pure moments (FE, bilateral AR, bilateral LB) in 4 equal steps to 7.5 Nm by pneumatic actuators, 3 load-unload cycles with 30 s creep per step; stereophotogrammetry on 3rd cycle; Euler angles (average of 6 permutations).
how_to_simulate: Model T11-L1 (two motion segments), no rib cage (floating-rib status not stated); fix L1
Apply pure moment up to 7.5 Nm to T11 in each direction, no preload, quasi-static
Report T11-T12 and T12-L1 rotation at 7.5 Nm (one direction) after 30 s creep
protocol.notes: NZ (Fig 6) and load-displacement curves (Figs 2-4) not digitised. Coupled values given in text.

extraction.check_notes: Coupled LB under AR to same side 0.4 +/- 0.7 at both levels; T12-L1 coupled flexion 0.2 +/- 0.9.
